rationale: The narrative is fully correct and grounded on two of the three requested facets: it names all 12 gold CAPEC ids (CAPEC-49, 55, 70, 509, 555, 560, 561, 565, 600, 644, 645, 652) with names matching the retrieved records exactly, and all 14 gold ATT&CK techniques (T1021, T1021.002, T1078, T1078.001, T1110.001-.004, T1114.002, T1133, T1550.002/.003, T1558, T1558.003) with correct names, matching must_correlate (14/14, deterministic recall/precision 1.0) and attack.must_include_ids (14/14) exactly. No invented facts were found — every CAPEC name, technique name, and mitigation name stated matches the evidence records verbatim (e.g. CAPEC-509 'Kerberoasting' -> T1558.003, CAPEC-644 'Use of Captured Hashes (Pass The Hash)' -> T1550.002), so faithfulness and groundedness are 1.0. However, the third facet of the question — 'what mitigations apply' — is answered very incompletely: gold's attack.must_include_related requires 19 distinct mitigation ids (M1013, M1015, M1017, M1018, M1021, M1026, M1027, M1030, M1032, M1035, M1036, M1037, M1041, M1042, M1043, M1047, M1051, M1052, M1060), all of which are present in the retrieved evidence (logic_flow q2 records), but the narrative only names 5 (M1032, M1027, M1036, M1026, M1018), omitting 14 gold-required mitigations including M1013 (Application Developer Guidance), M1015 (Active Directory Configuration), M1041 (Encrypt Sensitive Information), M1043 (Credential Access Protection), M1047 (Audit), M1060 (Out-of-Band Communications Channel), etc. Because a full third of the explicitly asked-for question (mitigations) is only ~26% surfaced despite being fully available in evidence, this is PARTIAL rather than CORRECT — accurate and well-grounded on CAPEC/ATT&CK mapping, but materially incomplete on the mitigations enumeration the question explicitly asked for.
